moments.frontstage: Each consumer international (USD/FX) remittance carries a 'Wire PAR or Disclosure Number' used for cancellation and error claims (S985), implying a disclosure/receipt at initiation; receipt wording not published. Since the May 2023 Union Bank conversion, consumer wire notifications are no longer supported by fax or phone and business accounts are set up for mail wire notification (S973). Remains inferred for current receipt/notification content.

touchpoints.screen: Cancel: 888.799.4737 Option 2 within 30 minutes of payment. Errors: 800.872.2657, any branch, or U.S. Bank Wire Transfer Dept, PO Box 64830, St. Paul, MN 55164-0830

moments.frontstage: 'You have the right to cancel a remittance transfer and obtain a refund of all funds paid to us, including any fees' if contacted within 30 minutes and funds not yet picked up/deposited; refund within three business days. Errors: contact within 180 days of the promised availability date with the Wire PAR or Disclosure Number; bank determines within 90 days and reports results within three business days. 'The recipient may receive less due to the fees charged by the intermediary bank and recipient's bank.' Recall after the 30-minute window and beneficiary-bank returns are not documented.

exceptions.customer_experience: Consumer calls 888.799.4737 Option 2 within 30 minutes of payment to cancel for a full refund including fees; later problems are raised as errors within 180 days, citing the Wire PAR or Disclosure Number
exceptions.bank_handling: Refund within three business days of a timely cancel if funds not yet picked up/deposited; error investigations decided within 90 days and results given within three business days. Recall after the cancel window is not described.

assessment: Consumers lack self-service international wires and any multi-currency remittance product; businesses gained digital USD international wires (promoted with Enhanced Payments, July 2026).
